name: Impossible Travel Identity Detection
description: Detects sign-ins from geographically improbable locations in a short time window.
queryDescription: Compare consecutive sign-ins by user and flag distance/time outliers.
recommendedResponse: Challenge active sessions and validate expected travel.

name: PowerShell Download Cradle
description: Flags PowerShell commands that retrieve remote payloads or scripts.
queryDescription: Match encoded PowerShell plus remote URL indicators.
recommendedResponse: Isolate endpoint and collect volatile artifacts.

name: Privileged Group Escalation Chain
description: Correlates suspicious sign-ins with high-impact role assignment events.
queryDescription: Join anomalous identity events with privileged group changes within 30 minutes.
recommendedResponse: Suspend the session and verify change authorization.

name: Unsanctioned Data Transfer Spike
description: Detects large outbound uploads to unsanctioned internet destinations.
queryDescription: Compare outbound transfer sizes against per-device baselines and destination categorization.
recommendedResponse: Review the transfer contents and restrict the destination if necessary.

name: Endpoint Agent Heartbeat Gap
description: Detects unexpected loss of endpoint telemetry from managed hosts.
queryDescription: Alert when endpoint agent heartbeat gap exceeds policy threshold.
recommendedResponse: Validate agent health and investigate concurrent posture drift.
